mathematical_hypothesis: A correctly specified 50/50 compositional/unrestricted Bayes-factor mixture is already optimal in expected Brier risk if the actual source-class frequency is exactly 50/50; learning the source-class prior alone cannot add expected accuracy under this matched distribution. Class recognition is information limited by overlap between the two rule distributions; T42 enumerates attainable class accuracy and conditional predictive risk from 0 to 8 public observed causal truth-table bits without another learned model.

causal_rule_families.C: Uniform over all 16x16x3 syntactic compositions G(a,b) OP H(b,c), OP in XOR/AND/OR, projected to a probability over all 256 three-input Boolean truth tables preserving syntactic multiplicities
causal_rule_families.U: Uniform over every one of 256 three-input Boolean truth tables, truly independent bits
causal_rule_families.grammar: Each of 16 two-input Boolean gates is represented by its complete 4-bit truth table. Exact causal program prior source-blind via projected counts over latent syntactic programs.

exact_exhaustive_protocol.each_k: Enumerate every combination of k distinct public causal input-pattern bits among 8 and every 2^k public output assignment. For each (mask,signature), independently sum projected composition and unrestricted source-prior masses.
exact_exhaustive_protocol.recognition: Bayes optimal source-class posterior odds from public Bayes factor, MAP source recognition accuracy, likelihood-ratio total variation and equivocation H(source|public), source/evidence mutual information in bits averaged across all input masks and output signatures weighted by generating probabilities.
exact_exhaustive_protocol.nonidentifiability: Quantify irreducible source-class Bayes classification error; at k=8 the unrestricted source still assigns positive probability to every complete eight-bit rule so class can never be recognized perfectly.
exact_exhaustive_protocol.forecast: For each k=0..7 and every unseen input bit target compute exact source-conditioned predictive probabilities and source-mixed expected Brier risk under actual mixture pi. Compare true-pi source-blind Bayes optimum, fixed 50/50 Bayes mixture, simple unrestricted 0.5 forecast, and evaluator-only clairvoyant class-known oracle. Average evenly over masks/targets and according to true event probabilities; no Monte Carlo.
exact_exhaustive_protocol.gain: report attainable relative reduction in expected Brier of correctly calibrated true-pi mixture versus fixed 0.5; class-known oracle upper bound as distinct unattainable information; do not call clairvoyant information a learned benefit.
exact_exhaustive_protocol.independent_checks: A separate direct 768-program source-class likelihood/predictive calculation must match the 256-table projected sums for all k for a deterministic independent set of input masks and each positive-probability response signature. Verify Bayes posterior normalization, nonnegative proper scoring regret, equality true-pi to fixed-50/50 at pi=0.5 to 1e-11, zero uniform-unrestricted unseen-bit information, exact class-error lower bound, and no full class identifiability at k=8.
exact_exhaustive_protocol.independent_result: no scientific source/regime labels revealed to a learned candidate, and no DEV generated.

decision.native_speed_not_claimed: This is an exact analytical information audit, not an executable learned model's native-performance qualification. Do not make any new science-firstuse or learned-cognition claim.
decision.scientific_HEADROOM_required: Report when even a hypothetically perfect source-class recognizer could improve forecast risk by >=5% over the matched true-prior mixture, and whether simply learning class prior could improve >=5% beyond fixed mixture under skewed source frequencies.
decision.prospective_requirements: If a later mechanism is warranted, it needs separate prereg, truly new source-born case IDs, TRAIN-only source-blind model selection with strong equally trained controls, independent exact verification, five whole-process CPU and RSS measures per arm on hosted Linux and Windows, and zero incorrect certifications before one authentic scientific first-use.
